card.name: Inside the word acetaminophen
card.fires_on: The middle piece "amin" in the spelling of acetaminophen, after "acet". It appears in drug lists, premedication lists and combination product names.

modes.description: The "amin" piece of acetaminophen when it is listed as a premedication or antipyretic.

card.writes: It promotes unrelated word-ending pieces and suppresses odd tokens, so there is no clear link to the next word.
